_comment: Copy to ~/.bcc/config.json and edit. One of these per Mac.
Feed assignment is hardcoded here on purpose: with two or three machines a
lease system is more moving parts than it is worth, and a fixed list means
you can look at a Mac and know what it is doing.
Put the ingest token in ~/.bcc/.ingest_secret (chmod 600). It never goes in
this file, so this file can be copied between machines and checked in.
audiotap      needs "app" (an application name, matched as a family so
Chrome's helper processes are included), or "pid", or
"system": true for everything the Mac is playing
